title: Best BJJ Gym Software: Prices & Belt Tracking (2026)
description: BJJ gym software compared: Kicksite, Martialytics, Gymdesk, Zen Planner and Spark on student-based pricing, trials and belt/stripe tracking.
body:
BJJ gyms need fast check-in, stripe and belt tracking, and recurring memberships. Here's how the main martial arts platforms compare on published prices.

{{table:kicksite,martialytics,gymdesk,zen-planner,spark-membership}}

Small gym (under 50 members)

Kicksite ($49 for ≤25, $99 for 26-50), Martialytics ($69 for ≤50) and Gymdesk ($75 with Gymdesk Payments) are the lowest published options. Kicksite names Jiu-Jitsu on its belt tracking feature.

Larger academy (150+ members)

Martialytics tops out at $199 for 200+ students, Kicksite at $199 for 101+, and Gymdesk at $200-$240 for 151-250. Zen Planner and Spark scale differently; see each tool page.

Related: best martial arts school software · all BJJ tools
faq: Kicksite and Spark Membership both say they serve Jiu-Jitsu schools. Spark has a dedicated BJJ gym software page.
What is the cheapest BJJ gym software?

Of the published prices we checked, Kicksite starts at $49/mo (0-25 students), Martialytics at $69/mo (0-50 students) and Gymdesk at $75/mo with Gymdesk Payments (up to 50 active members; $100/mo with your own processor).
Which BJJ gym software tracks belts and stripes?
Kicksite, Martialytics, Gymdesk, Zen Planner and Spark Membership all list belt or rank tracking on their sites.
Do BJJ gym software tools have free trials?
Martialytics and Gymdesk offer 30 days with no credit card, and Spark Membership offers 8 weeks. Kicksite says your first 30 days are free.
